headline: Energy Fuels Reports Q3 Results and Rare Earth Oxide Mill Expansion
summary: Energy Fuels announced Q3 results, completed its acquisition of ASM, and approved construction of commercial-scale heavy rare earth oxide circuits at its White Mesa Mill.
why: Energy Fuels is a U.S. producer of uranium and critical minerals working to build an integrated rare earth element supply chain.

impacts.name: Energy Fuels Inc.
impacts.why: The company reported quarterly financial results alongside progress on rare earth infrastructure initiatives.
